## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 180 captures during June 2020. This report summarises activity at the site for the month, including the number of captures completed and the outcomes available for review. The total of 180 captures provides the activity figure for the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 180 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent. These captures could not be used for grading, and are reported separately from the grading outcomes. The image-quality figures therefore comprise 180 total captures, 3 ungradable captures, and an ungradable rate of 1.7.

## Grading

Grading identified 33 referable results from the captures reviewed. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This provides the central measure of the time taken for grading during June 2020. The grading summary is therefore 33 referable results, with a median lag of 1 day, alongside the image-quality information reported above.
